t: 一支支持教宗亚历山大三世的罗马军队被布赫的克里斯蒂安和达塞尔的拉纳尔所击败.
te: A Roman army supporting Pope Alexander III is defeated by Christian of Buch and Rainald of Dassel.
dz: 蒙特波尔齐奥战役:一支支持教宗亚历山大三世的罗马军队被布赫的克里斯蒂安和达塞尔的拉纳尔所击败.
de: Battle of Monte Porzio: A Roman army supporting Pope Alexander III is defeated by Christian of Buch and Rainald of Dassel.

t: 拜占庭人在锡尔米乌姆果断地击败了匈牙利军队,迫使匈牙利人起诉求和.
te: The Byzantines defeat the Hungarian army decisively at Sirmium, forcing the Hungarians to sue for peace.
dz: 拜占庭人在锡尔米乌姆果断地击败了匈牙利军队,迫使匈牙利人起诉求和.
de: The Byzantines defeat the Hungarian army decisively at Sirmium, forcing the Hungarians to sue for peace.

t: 耶路撒冷国王阿马尔里克与拜占庭公主玛丽亚·科姆内(Maria Konnene)在提尔大教堂结婚.
te: King Amalric of Jerusalem marries Byzantine princess Maria Komnene in the cathedral of Tyre.
dz: 耶路撒冷国王阿马尔里克与拜占庭公主玛丽亚·科姆内(Maria Konnene)在提尔大教堂结婚.
de: King Amalric of Jerusalem marries Byzantine princess Maria Komnene in the cathedral of Tyre.
p: Cathedral of the Holy Cross, Tyre

t: 西西里人总理斯蒂芬·德·佩尔切将皇家宫廷迁至墨西拿来防止叛乱.
te: Sicilian Chancellor Stephen du Perche moves the royal court to Messina to prevent a rebellion.
dz: 西西里人总理斯蒂芬·德·佩尔切将皇家宫廷迁至墨西拿来防止叛乱.
de: Sicilian Chancellor Stephen du Perche moves the royal court to Messina to prevent a rebellion.
